title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps
abstract: arXiv:2608.15736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning. We construct a controlled benchmark of 5,760 maps and 28,800 questions spanning Attribute Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Pattern Delineate, and evaluate 21 open-source and proprietary multimodal FMs. Results show that hue choice has limited and inconsistent effects, whereas disrupting sequential color ordering substantially reduces performance, especially for comparison and ranking. Reduced lightness contrast also consistently impairs reasoning, while increasing contrast beyond sufficient separability provides only marginal gains. translated_title: 面向人工智能友好的制图学：理解颜色设计如何影响基础模型在顺序分级统计图上的空间推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15736v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基础模型（FMs）日益支持多模态和地理空间推理，但为人类感知设计的制图原则是否同样适用于机器仍不清楚。聚焦于顺序分级统计图，我们研究了色调调色板、颜色排序和明度对比度如何影响基础模型的空间推理。我们构建了一个受控基准，包含5，760张地图和28，800个问题，涵盖属性识别、空间识别、比较、排序和模式描绘，并评估了21个开源和专有的多模态基础模型。结果表明，色调选择的影响有限且不一致，而打乱顺序颜色排序会显著降低性能，尤其是在比较和排序任务中。降低明度对比度也持续损害推理能力，而将对比度增加到超过足够可分离性仅带来边际收益。LoRA微调提高了整体准确性，但保留了这些效应。
tldr: 本文发现，对于基础模型在顺序分级统计图上的空间推理，颜色排序和明度对比度比色调选择更关键，且对比度过度增加收益有限。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that for foundation model spatial reasoning on sequential choropleth maps, color ordering and lightness contrast matter more than hue choice, with diminishing returns from excessive contrast.
